long_biography.plain_text:
Yuri Milner's investment career began with a change of discipline. Trained in theoretical physics and quantum-field research, he studied business at Wharton and worked in the World Bank's financial sector. A conviction that the internet would reshape investment then led him to build Mail.ru and create DST Global, a platform for backing digital companies across international markets.

Milner later put his scientific background at the centre of his philanthropy. With Julia Milner and other partners, he established the Breakthrough Prizes for physics, life sciences and mathematics. The Breakthrough Initiatives added astronomy and engineering programmes, including searches for technological life and research on uncrewed interstellar travel. The physicist who changed careers now funds experimental work on some of the questions that first drew him to science.
